title: Your first post (example)
summary: A short summary shown on the blog page. Leave empty to use the start of the post.
body:
This is an example post to copy. In the CMS, open it, choose **Duplicate**, write your post, then switch on "Show on website".

## A heading

Write in plain paragraphs. Leave a blank line between paragraphs. Use the toolbar for **bold**, *italic*, lists, links and photos.

> A quote stands out like this.
